description: This file declares the ProductOptionService interface, which defines methods for managing product options within the system, including listing options by store, retrieving options by name or code, and saving or updating options.

classes.name: ProductOptionService
classes.description: Interface defining operations for product option management, extending a generic service for entity operations.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options available in a given merchant store, localized by language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options matching a given name within a store, localized by language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a store, localized by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option by its unique code within a store.
